AUT.stock_note: FAO's accounts put this country's opening stocks for 2024 at almost nothing, after several years in the millions or hundreds of thousands of tonnes. In these accounts the change in stocks is the figure that makes everything else balance, so a drop like that is usually the accounting closing, not the silos emptying. We publish no stock figure for this country this year rather than one we do not believe.
